title: Fantasy Football Loser Flag - Last Place Punishment
description:
Overview:
A bold, green-scoreboard style flag designed to make your league’s last-place manager wear (or wave) their defeat with good-natured shame. Printed phrase on the flag exactly as shown: Eyebrow: OFFICIAL LEAGUE RESULT
Main lines: FANTASY FOOTBALL
LOSER
Footer: LAST PLACE AND PROUD
This is the unmistakable fantasy football loser label for draft parties, watch parties, toilet-bowl events, end-of-season gatherings, or office banter.

Product details & verified facts:
- Double-sided print (same design on both sides)
- Suitable indoors or outdoors
- Printed to order
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included

Production & listing disclosure:
This listing and the layout were created with AI-assisted design and text input and are produced in partnership with a trusted print studio. Your flag is printed to order by our production partner.

Why it works:
The green scoreboard treatment and bold type make the message unmistakable from a distance — perfect for roast-style league fun without being mean-spirited. Use it as a gag gift, a draft-day prop, or a permanent reminder for the league’s worst lineup choices.

Notes for buyers:
- Flagpole, mounting hardware, and any staging props are not included.
- Printed to order: please allow production time before shipment (shipping time not promised here). If you have layout questions, message me and I’ll coordinate with the production partner.
rationale: Design direction: 'scoreboard' style with a green palette reflects the requested green scoreboard treatment and reads like an unmistakable loss label. Title choice: concise, under 15 words, and includes high-value search terms (Fantasy Football, Loser, Flag, Last Place Punishment) so buyers immediately know product type and intent.
